price_signal: €2270 for B car package; €60 theory online course; motor 1.5h lesson €88,50
notes: Small one-person school (1 werknemer) offering car (B), motorcycle (A1/A2/A/AM) and moped (bromfiets) lessons in the Den Bosch region. BOVAG-affiliated per rijschool-tips.nl. Founding/experience signals conflict: three aggregators (clickdrive, educar, rijschool-tips) state '37 jaar ervaring' (=> ~1989), while rijloket.nl says 'al meer dan 45 jaar actief' (=> before ~1981); used the more consistent 37-year figure. Car transmission (automaat vs schakel) not stated on the official site or aggregators; site only mentions automaat/schakel in the context of mopeds. No English-instruction evidence found; official site is Dutch-only, reviews are all Dutch. Mixed reviews; one strongly negative Google review describing the owner as gruff/hard to understand. Low CBR exam volume (~14-15/yr).
